APPLIANCES.interpretation: Scientific estimates are reported regardless of sign. PASS denotes only technical completeness and integrity, not support for a paper claim.

locality_diagnostics.multistep_geometry_limit: For replay_sgd, activation crossing is measured on the straight center-to-final-endpoint chord, not on every segment of the curved multi-step replay path. Taylor risk change remains endpoint-exact.

population.unit_of_analysis: actuator endpoint on the current destination packet

population.inclusion_rule: source packet powers a scored destination packet t+1
